halt_guidance.blocker: MARS-seq requires the experiment-specific plate barcode set, well/sample map, and confirmed barcode/UMI geometry.
required_inputs: Plate/well barcode list and well-to-sample manifest
Confirmed barcode, UMI, and cDNA read coordinates plus strandedness
next_steps: Obtain the barcode list and plate map from the study supplements or authors.
Validate barcode orientation and read roles against representative FASTQs.
Run zUMIs or an explicitly configured STARsolo workflow and confirm recovery of expected wells.
halt_guidance.resume: After supplying and validating the plate manifest and exact geometry, an explicit MARS-seq STARsolo target can be prepared.
